function.name: List ROS Topics
function.description: List all active ROS topics currently published in the system

function.name: List ROS2 Topics
function.description: List all active ROS2 topics currently published in the system

function.name: Echo ROS Topic
function.description: Display messages being published on a specific ROS topic. Usage: rostopic echo /topic_name

function.name: Echo ROS2 Topic
function.description: Display messages being published on a specific ROS2 topic. Usage: ros2 topic echo /topic_name

function.name: Get ROS Topic Info
function.description: Get information about a ROS topic including type, publishers, and subscribers. Usage: rostopic info /topic_name

function.name: Get ROS2 Topic Info
function.description: Get information about a ROS2 topic including type, publishers, and subscribers. Usage: ros2 topic info /topic_name

function.name: Get ROS Topic Hz
function.description: Display publishing rate (frequency) of a ROS topic. Usage: rostopic hz /topic_name

function.name: Get ROS2 Topic Hz
function.description: Display publishing rate (frequency) of a ROS2 topic. Usage: ros2 topic hz /topic_name

function.name: Publish to ROS Topic
function.description: Publish a message to a ROS topic. Usage: rostopic pub /topic_name msg_type 'data'

function.name: Publish to ROS2 Topic
function.description: Publish a message to a ROS2 topic. Usage: ros2 topic pub /topic_name msg_type 'data'

function.name: List ROS Nodes
function.description: List all active ROS nodes currently running in the system

function.name: List ROS2 Nodes
function.description: List all active ROS2 nodes currently running in the system

function.name: Get ROS Node Info
function.description: Get information about a ROS node including subscriptions, publications, and services. Usage: rosnode info /node_name

function.name: Get ROS2 Node Info
function.description: Get information about a ROS2 node including subscriptions, publications, and services. Usage: ros2 node info /node_name

function.name: Kill ROS Node
function.description: Kill/terminate a running ROS node. Usage: rosnode kill /node_name

function.name: List ROS Services
function.description: List all available ROS services in the system

function.name: List ROS2 Services
function.description: List all available ROS2 services in the system

function.name: Call ROS Service
function.description: Call a ROS service with arguments. Usage: rosservice call /service_name [args]

function.name: Call ROS2 Service
function.description: Call a ROS2 service with arguments. Usage: ros2 service call /service_name service_type 'args'

function.name: Get ROS Service Type
function.description: Get the message type of a ROS service. Usage: rosservice type /service_name

function.name: Get ROS2 Service Type
function.description: Get the message type of a ROS2 service. Usage: ros2 service type /service_name

function.name: List ROS Parameters
function.description: List all ROS parameters on the parameter server

function.name: List ROS2 Parameters
function.description: List all ROS2 parameters for a specific node. Usage: ros2 param list /node_name

function.name: Get ROS Parameter
function.description: Get the value of a ROS parameter. Usage: rosparam get /parameter_name

function.name: Get ROS2 Parameter
function.description: Get the value of a ROS2 parameter. Usage: ros2 param get /node_name parameter_name

function.name: Set ROS Parameter
function.description: Set the value of a ROS parameter. Usage: rosparam set /parameter_name value

function.name: Set ROS2 Parameter
function.description: Set the value of a ROS2 parameter. Usage: ros2 param set /node_name parameter_name value

function.name: Record ROS Bag
function.description: Record ROS topics to a bag file. Usage: rosbag record -a (all topics) or rosbag record /topic1 /topic2

function.name: Record ROS2 Bag
function.description: Record ROS2 topics to a bag file. Usage: ros2 bag record -a (all topics) or ros2 bag record /topic1 /topic2

function.name: Play ROS Bag
function.description: Play back a recorded ROS bag file. Usage: rosbag play bagfile.bag

function.name: Play ROS2 Bag
function.description: Play back a recorded ROS2 bag file. Usage: ros2 bag play bagfile

function.name: Get ROS Bag Info
function.description: Display information about a ROS bag file. Usage: rosbag info bagfile.bag

function.name: Get ROS2 Bag Info
function.description: Display information about a ROS2 bag file. Usage: ros2 bag info bagfile

function.name: Run ROS Launch File
function.description: Launch a ROS launch file. Usage: roslaunch package_name launch_file.launch

function.name: Run ROS2 Launch File
function.description: Launch a ROS2 launch file. Usage: ros2 launch package_name launch_file.py

function.name: Run ROS Node
function.description: Run a ROS node from a package. Usage: rosrun package_name node_name

function.name: Run ROS2 Node
function.description: Run a ROS2 node from a package. Usage: ros2 run package_name node_name

function.name: View TF Tree
function.description: Display the transform tree structure in ROS. Usage: rosrun tf view_frames

function.name: View ROS2 TF Tree
function.description: Display the transform tree structure in ROS2. Usage: ros2 run tf2_tools view_frames

function.name: Echo TF Transform
function.description: Display transform between two frames. Usage: rosrun tf tf_echo source_frame target_frame

function.name: Echo ROS2 TF Transform
function.description: Display transform between two frames in ROS2. Usage: ros2 run tf2_ros tf2_echo source_frame target_frame

function.name: List ROS Packages
function.description: List all available ROS packages in the workspace

function.name: List ROS2 Packages
function.description: List all available ROS2 packages in the workspace

function.name: Find ROS Package
function.description: Find the path to a ROS package. Usage: rospack find package_name

function.name: Find ROS2 Package
function.description: Find the path to a ROS2 package. Usage: ros2 pkg prefix package_name

function.name: Show ROS Message Definition
function.description: Display the definition of a ROS message type. Usage: rosmsg show message_type

function.name: Show ROS2 Message Definition
function.description: Display the definition of a ROS2 message type. Usage: ros2 interface show message_type

function.name: Check ROS Master Status
function.description: Check if ROS master is running and get its URI

function.name: Start ROS Core
function.description: Start the ROS master node (roscore)

function.name: Build ROS Workspace
function.description: Build a ROS catkin workspace. Usage: catkin_make or catkin build

function.name: Build ROS2 Workspace
function.description: Build a ROS2 workspace using colcon. Usage: colcon build

function.name: Source ROS Workspace
function.description: Source the ROS workspace setup file

function.name: Source ROS2 Workspace
function.description: Source the ROS2 workspace setup file

function.name: RViz Visualization
function.description: Launch RViz for 3D visualization of robot and sensor data

function.name: RViz2 Visualization
function.description: Launch RViz2 for 3D visualization of robot and sensor data in ROS2

function.name: rqt GUI
function.description: Launch rqt, the Qt-based GUI framework for ROS

function.name: rqt Graph
function.description: Visualize the ROS computation graph showing nodes and topics

function.name: ROS2 Daemon Status
function.description: Check the status of the ROS2 daemon

function.name: ROS2 Doctor
function.description: Run diagnostics on ROS2 installation and check for issues

function.name: List ROS2 Actions
function.description: List all available ROS2 action servers

function.name: Get ROS2 Action Info
function.description: Get information about a ROS2 action. Usage: ros2 action info /action_name

function.name: Send ROS2 Action Goal
function.description: Send a goal to a ROS2 action server. Usage: ros2 action send_goal /action_name action_type 'goal'
